sections.Profile:
"Samba" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by the French manufacturer Alben in 1961. The game features a festive theme, incorporating four flippers, three pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, and two gobble holes.

- Manufacturer: Alben
- Years made: 1961
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Good Times, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme, Festival, Music
